mapper.sql: select id, parent_id, name, title, tag, icon, summary, sort, description, created_time, created_by, updated_time, updated_by from category
mapper.select:
and parent_id = #{parentId}
order by parent_id, sort, id
mapper.insert: insert into category (parent_id, name, title, tag, icon, summary, sort, description, created_time, updated_time, created_by, updated_by) values (#{parentId}, #{name}, #{title}, #{tag}, #{icon}, #{summary}, #{sort}, #{description}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
